annotations.text: Five NEW widget concepts for Jersey Tides, alongside the shipped Dial / Chart / Accessories. Same two-hue system: sea for everything tidal, dawn for sun & moon, on the sky ground. Each artboard has a dark-mode tweak (chip above the frame).

TIDE CLOCK — the classic 12 h 25 m instrument: needle climbs the left side to HIGH, falls down the right to LOW. Instantly readable at a glance from across the room.
Tradeoff: no absolute heights on the face.

GAUGE — the day's range as a filled column: where the water sits between today's LW and HW right now.
Tradeoff: least information of the set, but strongest single read.

SCHEDULE — the next four turnings as stations on a line, countdown on the first. For planning the next 24 h without reading a curve.
Tradeoff: no shape-of-day; text-first.

WEEK — seven days of shrinking/growing cycles plus each morning's HW. Shows the springs-to-neaps drift and how HW walks ~50 min later per day.
Tradeoff: one number per day only.

FORTNIGHT — 14 daily max-HW bars: the full springs–neaps breathing cycle, moon quarter/new marks in dawn, next springs called out. Unique to a computed-offline app — no API could give this for free.
Tradeoff: zero about today's hours; pairs with a small.
